Hi Claire — thanks for the PO and for flagging the tax request. Appreciate the timeline.

High level: we can reissue a split invoice that shows net usage per jurisdiction and include a tax summary. However, GST withholding (withholding at source) is jurisdiction-specific — Redwood does not normally withhold GST in Singapore. We do have a self-billing flow for customers who prefer we issue invoices that match their local reporting, but that requires a signed self-billing agreement and a short verification step.

Next steps I suggest:
- Ben, can you take the PO and draft a split invoice using the attached template? I put a proposed timeline of 48 hours for the draft (Ben: please confirm).
- Marissa, can you confirm whether we can provide a GST registration cert or alternative tax evidence for Singapore, and if a self-billing agreement is needed for LumenHealth Pte Ltd?

Claire — I’ve attached an internal invoice split template so Ben can populate the line items against the PO. If you can also confirm the exact Lumen entity to which we should bill (the PO lists LumenHealth Pte Ltd), that will speed things up.

Hannah / Ben / Claire,

Brief tax note for clarity:
- Singapore (where LumenHealth Pte Ltd is incorporated) does not currently implement a reverse-charge GST mechanism for cross-border SaaS supplied from outside Singapore. If the supply is made by Redwood (US-headquartered) to a Singapore GST-registered business, the customer may have GST reporting obligations, but Redwood is not required to withhold or collect GST on that basis.
- Some APAC markets (India) do have withholding requirements on certain services — if the customer were an India tax resident that would be a different conversation.
- For customers that need invoices structured for their local AP system we can support a self-billing arrangement — we will need a signed self-billing agreement before we regularly auto-issue those invoices on their behalf.

Requested evidence we can provide:
- Redwood company registration + US EIN (available immediately)
- If you need formal GST registration in SG, note: Redwood does not have a Singapore GST registration to provide (we will flag this on the invoice).

Proposed operational approach:
1) Reissue invoice with two line groups: 
   - "Singapore-sourced usage (reported gross)" (net amount + note: customer to self-assess GST if applicable)
   - "Non-SG usage / export of services (no GST)"
2) Add a short tax footnote stating: "Redwood Inference (US) is not registered for GST in Singapore. Customer has responsibility to self-assess under Singapore GST rules where applicable."
3) If LumenHealth prefers RedWood to act as self-biller, have them sign the attached self_billing_agreement_draft.pdf and provide a tax residency certificate / W8/W9 equivalent.

Ben — please draft the split invoice (use the template Hannah attached). Once draft is ready, Hannah please forward to Claire so they can confirm and we can reissue the final PDF. Aim: final invoice out by EOD 2026-12-04 so LumenHealth can clear payment by 12/10.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Tax & Compliance
Redwood Inference
